Name: (AT) Pride Lamps (Plus Cute Valley Pride Lamps)
Author: BeneathThePlass
Description:
Have you seen [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/210387900]BogWyytch's[/url] lovely [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24793]Bog's PRIDE Lamps[/url] mod and thought... well, those are absolutely great, but they don't quite match the aesthetic of your farm? Have you wished for more vanilla lamps that [i]also[/i] had pride banners on them to show off your pride on your farm? Well, your wish is now answered! I come bearing my new [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]AT[/url]] Pride Lamps mod, with almost vanilla lamps bearing pride banners for a great variety of pride flags! This is a content pack for the fantastic [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mod, by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4112039]PeacefulEnd[/url]. It includes both iron and wood lamps, and it includes the following pride flags;

[list]
[*]Pride
[*]Pride Progress
[*]Abrosexual
[*]Androgyne
[*]Aromantic
[*]Aromantic Asexual
[*]Asexual
[*]Bigender
[*]Bisexual
[*]Demisexual
[*]Gay Man
[*]Genderfluid
[*]Genderqueer
[*]Greysexual
[*]Intersex
[*]Leather
[*]Lesbian
[*]Neutrois
[*]Nonbinary
[*]Omnisexual
[*]Pansexual
[*]Polysexual
[*]Polyamorous
[*]Transgender
[/list]
Textures also come in both vanilla colors, plus colors to match the Cute Valley colors in blue, pink, and purple!



[b]Installation:[/b]
[b]1. [/b]Make sure that you have both [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] correctly installed in your Stardew Valley folder.
[b]2. [/b]Unzip the '[AT] Pride Lamps' folder and drop it into your 'Mods' folder in the main SDV game folder.
[b]3. [/b]Buy the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]Paint Bucket[/url] tool from Robin, to use on your items and retexture them.
[b]4. [/b]Congrats, you're done and ready to retexture! Enjoy your new lamps!



[b]Credits:[/b]
[list]
[*]Massive credit, of course, to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/210387900]BogWyytch[/url]﻿, as they created the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24793]Bog's PRIDE Lamps[/url] mod﻿ that inspired this mod!
[/list]
